title: Boolean column crashes mypy plugin

labels.name: great mcve
labels.description: An issue with a great mcve

labels.name: SQLA mypy plugin
labels.description: mypy plugin issues only.  general pep-484 issues should be "typing"

body:
**Describe the bug**
Using a `Boolean` column in an ORM class crashes the mypy plugin

**Expected behavior**
`mypy` should exit with `Success: no issues found in 1 source file`

**To Reproduce**

```py
from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Column
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base

Base = declarative_base()


class TestBoolean(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'test_boolean'

    flag = Column(Boolean)
```

**mypy.ini**

```
[mypy]
plugins = sqlalchemy.ext.mypy.plugin
```

**Error**

```
$ mypy --show-traceback test_boolean.py    
test_boolean.py:7: error: INTERNAL ERROR -- Please try using mypy master on Github:
https://mypy.rtfd.io/en/latest/common_issues.html#using-a-development-mypy-build
Please report a bug at https://github.com/python/mypy/issues
version: 0.812
```
